test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical/spelling error.

Jack along with / his family visited / his aunt living / at America.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the preposition **"at"** instead of **"in"** before the term **"America."**
 
• When referring to a country, the correct preposition to use is **"in."**
 
• The correct phrase should be **"in America,"** ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Jack along with his family visited his aunt living **in America**."*
